views.name: checklist_overview
views.definition:
SELECT i.id,
    i.task_id,
    t.project_id,
    i.percentage,
    i.is_completed,
    i.comment,
    i.deadline_at,
    i.sync_version
   FROM ((task_items i
     JOIN tasks t ON ((t.id = i.task_id)))
     JOIN projects p ON ((p.id = t.project_id)))
  WHERE ((NOT i.is_archived) AND (t.status <> 'archived'::task_status) AND (p.status = 'active'::project_status));

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.bump_task_item_sync_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
    if pg_catalog.current_setting('tasktrace.force_sync_version_bump', true) = 'on'
       or new.percentage is distinct from old.percentage
       or new.is_completed is distinct from old.is_completed
       or new.comment is distinct from old.comment
       or new.is_archived is distinct from old.is_archived
       or new.deadline_at is distinct from old.deadline_at then
      new.sync_version := old.sync_version + 1;
    else new.sync_version := old.sync_version; end if;
    return new;
end;
$function$

functions.arguments: p_deadline timestamp with time zone, p_percentage integer, p_inactive boolean, p_now timestamp with time zone
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.checklist_deadline_status(p_deadline timestamp with time zone, p_percentage integer, p_inactive boolean, p_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select case when p_deadline is null or p_inactive then 'inactive'
        when p_percentage = 100 then 'completed'
        when p_now >= p_deadline then 'overdue'
        when p_now >= p_deadline - interval '12 hours' then 'urgent'
        else 'normal' end;
$function$

functions.name: lock_project_role
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.lock_project_role(p_project_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS project_role
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'private', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
    v_role public.project_role;
begin
    select role into v_role
      from public.project_members
     where project_id = p_project_id and user_id = p_user_id
     for update;
    return v_role;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_task_item_last_editors(p_task_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(task_item_id uuid, user_id uuid, display_name text, changed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'private', 'public'
AS $function$
    with task_context as (
        select t.id, t.project_id
          from public.tasks t
         where t.id = p_task_id
           and private.has_task_access(p_task_id)
    ), item_ids as (
        select ti.id
          from public.task_items ti
          join task_context tc on tc.id = ti.task_id
    ), ranked as (
        select a.entity_id as task_item_id,
               a.user_id,
               a.created_at as changed_at,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by a.entity_id
                   order by a.created_at desc, a.id desc
               ) as row_number
          from public.audit_log a
          join item_ids i on i.id = a.entity_id
          join task_context tc on tc.project_id = a.project_id
         where a.entity_type = 'task_item'
           and a.action <> 'created'
           and not (
               a.action = 'updated'
               and coalesce(a.old_data, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'title'
               and coalesce(a.new_data, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'title'
               and (coalesce(a.old_data, '{}'::jsonb) - 'title') =
                   (coalesce(a.new_data, '{}'::jsonb) - 'title')
           )
    )
    select r.task_item_id,
           r.user_id,
           nullif(p.display_name, '') as display_name,
           r.changed_at
      from ranked r
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = r.user_id
     where r.row_number = 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notification_filter_options()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with notices as (
    select n.* from public.notifications n where n.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  ), projects as (
    select n.project_id as id,
      max(coalesce(p.name, n.data->>'project_name', 'Проект ' || left(n.project_id::text, 8))) as name
    from notices n left join public.projects p on p.id = n.project_id
    where n.project_id is not null group by n.project_id
  ), tasks as (
    select n.task_id as id, n.project_id,
      max(coalesce(t.title, n.data->>'task_title', 'Этап ' || left(n.task_id::text, 8))) as title
    from notices n left join public.tasks t on t.id = n.task_id
    where n.task_id is not null group by n.task_id, n.project_id
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'projects', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(p order by p.name, p.id) from projects p), '[]'::jsonb),
    'tasks', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(t order by t.title, t.id) from tasks t), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
$function$
